title: Traditional Dutch Paasstamppot with Chicken
description: A hearty Dutch dish made with boiled potatoes, kale, sausage, and chicken, perfect for Easter.
instructions: Boil the chopped potatoes in water until tender. Drain and set aside.
In a large pan, cook the sliced sausage over medium heat until browned. Remove the sausage from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add the chopped kale and cook until wilted. Add the cooked sausage back in and set aside.

Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper. Sear the chicken in a hot pan until browned on both sides. Finish cooking the chicken in the oven until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
In a large saucepan, combine the cooked potatoes, kale and sausage mixture, and chicken. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Roll out the flaky pastry to fit the top of a 9x13-inch dish. Place the pastry on top of the potato mixture and crimp the edges to seal.
Bake the paasstamppot in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Serve the paasstamppot hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
